name: METFORMIN / GLIMEPIRIDE 850MG/4MG 16 EXTENDED-RELEASE TABLETS
description: Metformin/Glimepiride 850mg/4mg (extended release) is used to treat type 2 diabetes in adults, combining two blood sugar-lowering medications: metformin reduces glucose production, and glimepiride stimulates the pancreas to produce more insulin and improves its use. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
